text:
Aisha (CS): quick heads-up from today's onboarding trio — three recurring asks: per-route cost visibility in Console, embeddings staleness / reindex trigger, and a bulk CSV export of feature asks for stakeholders.
Tom P: heard the same — two customers explicitly called out renewal anxiety if costs keep surprising them. flagged as potential renewal risk.
Riley (PM): thanks. prioritization thought: quick wins first — 1) per-route breakdown toggle, 2) CSV export of feature requests, 3) embeddings "reindex" button. my priority order: toggle > export > reindex. @Jorge can you eyeball effort? :thinking_face: 
Jorge (Eng): rough estimates from infra side: per-route breakdown (UI + backend rollup) ~2w, CSV export ~3d, reindex button depends on indexing infra but ~1w optimistic. need a telemetry event `feedback_capture.created` and route-level token metrics to be stored.
Aisha (CS): proposing a lightweight triage score to surface the top items to PM/eng: `score = (tier_weight*3) + (renewal_risk*4) + (severity*2)` where tier_weight: Enterprise=3, Mid=2, SMB=1. i'll batch top 8 requests after scoring.
Riley (PM): perfect. can you paste 1-2 verbatim quotes for context in the ticket?
Aisha (CS): "We can't tell which routes are eating tokens — our support bot keeps spiking costs and we only find out on the invoice."
Aisha (CS): "Embeddings drifted after a model swap — we need a manual reindex button or a webhook to trigger re-embedding."
feedback-bot: created ticket CS-4720 "Per-route cost breakdown" and linked CS-4721 "Feature-asks bulk export". assigned CS-4720 -> @Riley (PM).
Tom P: :+1: added account IDs and renewal windows to CS-4720 (accounts: ACME-112, NOVA-44).
Jorge (Eng): i'll tentatively slot the per-route toggle into next sprint backlog, will follow up with exact burndown after PLanning.
Riley (PM): confirmed — adding both CS-4720 and CS-4721 to sprint planning board. thanks for quick capture everyone :raised_hands:
Aisha (CS): will send the scored list + verbatim quote bundle by EOD and ping stakeholders.
Tom P: thanks — flag if any blockers on telemetry so we can surface in customer comms."
